---
title: "Supplemental Materials"
subtitle: "Evaluating Open-Weight Large Language Models for Structured Depression Assessment from Clinical Interviews"
---

This site hosts the supplemental analysis reports and source code for:

> Girard, J. M., Kebe, G. Y., Morency, L.-P., De la Torre, F., Liebenthal, E., & Baker, J. T. (in press). Evaluating open-weight large language models for structured depression assessment from clinical interviews. *Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science*.

## Analysis Reports

Each report is a rendered Quarto document containing the complete analysis code
and output. The corresponding source files (`.qmd`) are available in the
[source folder](https://github.com/jmgirard/llm-depression-assessment/tree/main/src).

| Report | Description |
|---|---|
| [Performance Analyses](analyses/performance_analyses.html) | Benchmarking of 25 open-weight LLMs on MADRS item and total score prediction; direct vs. indirect scoring comparison; error characterization |
| [Fairness Analyses](analyses/fairness_analyses.html) | Psychometric fairness audit (bias, sensitivity, precision) across sex, age, race, education, primary diagnosis, and interviewer |
| [Ablation Analyses](analyses/ablation_analyses.html) | Prompt ablation study isolating the contributions of descriptive and demonstrative cues |
| [Ensemble Analyses](analyses/ensemble_analyses.html) | Comparison of cross-model ensemble aggregation to the best single model |

## Data Availability

The interview recordings and transcripts analyzed in this work cannot be
publicly shared because they contain identifiable protected health information
from psychiatric inpatients. The analysis reports above include all code
required to reproduce the reported results; the deidentified model prediction
files they operate on are available from the corresponding author upon
reasonable request.
